SETTINGS.TITLE: MATCH SETTINGS
SETTINGS.HOST_ONLY: Only the host can change these
SETTINGS.READ_ONLY: Match settings are set by the host
SETTINGS.EXPLANATION_TIME: Time to explain after the buzz

ERRORS.EVEN: The number of rounds must be even.

TOOLTIP.ROUND_TIME: Countdown time for the player giving the clues. Between 30 seconds and 10 minutes.
TOOLTIP.NUMBER_OF_ROUNDS: Total number of rounds. It must be an even number so both teams play the same amount of times. At least 1 round per participant is recommended.
TOOLTIP.SKIP_LIMIT: How many cards the player can skip per turn. Check the option to make each skip cost points.
TOOLTIP.TIPOO_LEAD_LIMIT: If a team opens this point lead over the other, the match ends. Minimum of 10 points. Disable to never end by lead.
TOOLTIP.EXPLANATION_TIME: Extra time (up to 15s) given to the player who buzzed to explain the forbidden word. The one who buzzed is the one who explains. 0 disables the extra time.
TOOLTIP.POINTS_CORRECT: Points earned for each correct guess.
TOOLTIP.POINTS_ERROR: Points deducted for each wrong card (buzz).
TOOLTIP.POINTS_SKIP: Points deducted for each skipped card.
TOOLTIP.DIFFICULTIES: Which card difficulty levels are in the match. Select at least 1.
TOOLTIP.BUZZER_SOUNDS: Which sound effects can play on the buzzer. With random sound enabled, one of them is drawn on each buzz.
TOOLTIP.STARTING_TEAM: Which team starts the first round. Random avoids the starting advantage.
TOOLTIP.TIEBREAK: What to do if the match ends tied: end tied or add one round for each team.
TOOLTIP.PAUSE_BETWEEN_ROUNDS: Transition time between rounds for score and buzz review. Between 15 seconds and 5 minutes.
TOOLTIP.PANIC_MODE: Hides the countdown timer from players during rounds.

SETTINGS.BUZZER_WARNING: No buzzer selected. This may affect the game experience, but players can use their own buzzers.
